release_notes: Battle Calculator now supported from troop level 3 and upwards, also working in background mode

android.release_notes:
TB Tools 1.0.3: Write to game is more reliable: it puts each number straight into the game's box and checks on the screen that it's there -- if not, it tries again another way, and tells you which troops didn't go in. On phones where the numbers didn't land (some Xiaomi phones) it now works. The attack report reading also stops sooner when your report has no higher monsters, or no troops of a type at those tiers.

TB Tools 1.0.2: Setup now has "From the game" at the top: 1. read an attack report, 2. read the Start march screen, then save -- no more scrolling. The report reading is faster: it starts at the bottom (highest tiers first) and stops as soon as it has every troop type your record needs, and it now also picks up the Legitimist and Josephine.

TB Tools 1.0.1: Read from the game fills in what it could read, even if a line was missed; Write to game now works on Xiaomi phones (Game Turbo) and with Gboard; the Cannoneer is built in.

TB Tools 1.0.0 - the big one: the Battle Calculator is now in the app!
- Battle Calculator tab: your records and lists, the same as on the website.
- Read from an attack report: open a report in the Journal and the app taps through your troops and fills in Strength, Health and Strength against epic monsters by itself.
- Read from the game: Leadership, Authority and Dominance straight from the Start march screen.
- Write to game: the app types your list's troop counts into the march screen for you (built-in pictures for most troops; calibrate a troop once if it isn't found).
- Crypting: posts the crypt location in Clan chat again, taps Retry when the game loses its connection, and the Stop button shows how far the run is (12/100).
Stack like a pro - no more excuses for poor attacks!
